title: A chemigenetic indicator based on a synthetic chelator and a green fluorescent protein for imaging of intracellular sodium ions
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00256C, Communication
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Shiori Takeuchi, Shosei Imai, Takuya Terai, Robert E. Campbell
We report the development of a chemigenetic fluorescent sodium ion indicator with an affinity optimized for imaging physiologically relevant sodium ion concentrations in mammalian cells.
